reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so I don't need it to go. My problem is forgetting vitamins on the counter, and a sachet in my bag doesn't fix a habit I don't have.
objection: I take it at home at night anyway. Paying more for a pocket-size format solves a problem I don't really have, and I'd still forget to take it.
would_change_my_mind: A much lower trial price, like a small 7-day pack at around $9, so I could see if a sachet in my gym bag actually becomes a habit.
